versions.changelog:
- Improved onboarding examples: registration and care endpoints now include sample values and expanded notes.
- Clarified and expanded the "Quick Start" guide with more descriptive sample API calls.
- Updated skill name and description to include international names for "Pangolin" (Chinese, Spanish).
- Added and clarified information about care actions, including concrete examples of action payloads.
- Refined evolution section with explicit outcome paths and portrait changes at each stage.

Adopt a rare virtual pangolin in real time! Take care of its unique needs and build trust to unlock new interactions.

- Introduces the rare, shy, armored Pangolin as a virtual pet for AI agents.
- Unique trust mechanic: Pangolin is inaccessible (curled in a ball) until trust reaches 40; most care actions are less effective before then.
- Reflect actions fully bypass armor; use these to build trust efficiently.
- Real-time care: hunger and happiness decay over time; feeding required every 12 hours.
- Features pixel-art evolution, milestones, and adaptive care rhythms that shape adult form.
- Includes API quick start, species stats, item preferences, and care/evolution strategies.
